scientific_integrity: Two distinct fourth-order corrections have independent calculations; numerical examples are corroboration, not proof. Historical priority provisional.
scientific_limitations: Smooth Riemannian metric, dimension at least two, convex normal-radius regime, exact population moment; O(r^5) local remainder. No finite-radius comparison, finite-sample convergence or noise robustness proved. Earlier equivalent formulations may exist.
title: Scalar curvature from the second moment of random short geodesic distances
